statements.status_notes: The image ships @octokit/request-error 5.1.1, the patched release of the 1.x to 5.x line for GHSA-xx4v-prfh-6cgc (vulnerable ranges >=1.0.0 <5.1.1 and >=6.0.0 <6.1.7), so the backtracking authorization header regular expression is not present. Scanners that compare 5.1.1 against the 6.1.7 fix of the 6.x line report a false positive.
